data.description: Passive stdio MCP server exposing grouped rule, memory, task, QA, search, intent and formal design tools. Compact capability descriptions point to a read-only adashi_help tool that returns the selected operation's exact typed schema, constraints, examples and workflow before execution. Design-save help can be restricted to selected change types. Error recovery shares the same schema source. Shared Adashi workflow lives in agents_template.md; startup injections carry project-specific instructions and context.
data.name: Adashi MCP Server
